title: FIELDLIST membership, DXF version floor, and id-set flag research
mode: Primary-source web research plus local source audit; plan-only
scope: Separate FIELDLIST owner group 330 from repeated soft-pointer member group 330, FIELD ID-valued group 330, and host reachability.
Reconcile ODA object-version and DXF field-code references with the local FIELD/FIELDLIST writer version gates.
Pin ACadRust 0.6.5 package/source behavior for optional FIELDLIST group 290 without treating source comments as native interoperability evidence.
Refine the existing PAR-20/7G implementation order and retain the quick-validation/self-unblocking policy.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
observations: FIELD and FIELDLIST are listed as R18 classes; FIELDLIST is an AcDbIdSet stored at the NOD ACAD_FIELDLIST entry.
FIELD child references are hard-owner 360 and FIELD object references are soft-pointer 331; Autodesk's DXF table also assigns group 330 to an ID-valued field value as a soft pointer.
FIELDLIST has a count and repeated group-330 soft-pointer field members; its unknown DWG bit has no DXF group-code mapping in the table.
limits: Specification evidence does not establish consumer acceptance of the local writer's literal output.
An unmapped DWG bit does not by itself prove that group 290 must be rejected in DXF.

sources.name: Autodesk FIELD DXF reference
observations: Documents FIELD child IDs as group 360 hard ownership, expression object IDs as group 331 soft pointers, and group 330 as a soft-pointer ID value when the value type is ID.
Its group-0 label uses ACAD_FIELD; local literal emission uses FIELD, so exact emitted spelling remains a separate unresolved producer question.

sources.name: Autodesk Developer field enumeration note
observations: States that the NOD ACAD_FIELDLIST entry identifies a FIELDLIST object.
Describes FIELD objects as typically reachable from host extension dictionaries and enumerates AcDbField members through group 330 on FIELDLIST.
limits: The post is version-specific R19 API guidance and uses 'typically'; it does not prove every host route or producer's DXF group-0 spelling.

sources.name: Autodesk Field feature introduction note
observations: Describes Fields as introduced in AutoCAD 2005, supporting an AC1018/R18 target-floor candidate.
limits: This is product-version evidence; it is not a complete DXF writer compatibility matrix.

sources.name: ACadRust v0.6.5 exact published package source
observations: The FIELDLIST writer source comment says the reference application does not write id-set flag 290 and emits it only when the stored unknown flag is true.
The docs.rs package index resolves latest to 0.6.5, correcting the earlier review note that exact 0.6.5 package source was unavailable.
limits: Neither the ACadRust executable nor AutoCAD/native output was run; this is source-level peer evidence only.
The registry archive checksum was not resolved in this pass.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw parser/writer/tests
observations: The FIELD/FIELDLIST writer gates allow AC1015; the ODA class and Autodesk product-version references make AC1018 the minimum-version candidate for qualification.
FIELDLIST parsing explicitly distinguishes preamble owner group 330 from AcDbIdSet member group 330 through subclass state and validates count 90 against membership size.
The writer remaps member handles and emits a bounded sentinel-tested sequence, but always emits group 290 even for m_unknown == 0.
The current low-level FIELD wire candidate asserts expression group 331 but does not include an ID-valued cache field to exercise FIELD group 330.
The typed FIELDLIST value does not distinguish an omitted group 290 from an explicitly parsed 290:0; the public presence/ABI policy is unresolved.
The adapter graph validator requires exact unique FIELDLIST membership closure, while dx_iface deliberately refuses FIELD/FIELDLIST graph export.
limits: No current native rejection or interoperability defect was reproduced.
The plan-only pass did not execute local tests or modify production/test code.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-20/7G: retain FIELDLIST count, soft-pointer membership, owner group-330, and FIELD ID-value group-330 roles independently.
PAR-20/7G: add a fast AC1015/AC1018 FIELD/FIELDLIST writer floor control; AC1018 is a source-backed candidate floor.
PAR-20/7G: characterize FIELDLIST 290 false/true emission and explicit-presence policy in ASCII and Binary; keep 290:0 as an unconfirmed writer-policy discrepancy.
PAR-20/7G: add a generated FIELD ID-valued group-330 control, separate from FIELDLIST membership and object-owner group 330.
PAR-20/7G: preserve low-level writer checks and strict adapter refusal as separate capability gates.

limitations: ODA specifies FIELD/FIELDLIST DWG class layouts and version, but does not prescribe all target DXF writer policies.
ACadRust 0.6.5 source is pinned and inspected but not executed; its comment does not constitute independent native acceptance.
The existing low-level FIELD candidate does not yet assert group 330 for an ID-valued FIELD cache; this is a fast test addition, not a confirmed local data loss.
If exact tag-level round-trip requires preserving explicit FIELDLIST 290:0, presence needs representation separate from the boolean value and public ABI implications must be reviewed.
The AC1018 threshold is a candidate based on R18 class metadata and AutoCAD 2005 feature introduction; verify exact target-version policy before changing the guard.
Autodesk's FIELD table's ACAD_FIELD label and local FIELD literal remain unresolved without a native-produced wire example.
